source.productFamily: Altistart 22 (ATS22) soft starter for induction motors

equipmentScope.scopeWarning: Confirm the full ATS22 model code and nameplate before applying any family-specific wiring, voltage, or configuration information.

safety.instruction: Work only by qualified personnel. Isolate all energy sources, including external control supplies, and apply site lockout/tagout before inspection or maintenance.

evidence.section: Safety instructions; exact page not independently rechecked

safety.instruction: Semiconductor switching does not provide complete isolation; hazardous voltage may remain on the load side while line-side power is present.

evidence.section: Safety instructions; exact page not independently rechecked

safety.instruction: For SCF (short-circuit) indication, stop the equipment and follow the approved isolation and inspection procedure. Do not restart merely by clearing the fault.
Do not install power-factor-correction capacitors on the soft-starter output. Isolate the ATS22 before insulation or high-voltage tests.

evidence.section: Installation and maintenance instructions; exact page not independently rechecked

wiringRules.statement: Inside-delta connection is supported only for ATS22-Q family under the manual's stated conditions; line voltage must not exceed 440 Vac, phase sequence 1-2-3, parameter dLtA=dLt, and wiring must follow the exact model diagram.
For inside-delta connection, parameter In is motor nameplate current divided by square root of 3; for line connection use the motor nameplate rated current.
